title: France arrests 1,200 as protests turn violent
title_zh: 法国抗议演变成暴力冲突，1200多人被抓

image.credit: Photo by Pawel Janiak on Unsplash
image.author: Pawel Janiak

lead: Violence erupted across France on Saturday as hundreds of thousands marched against hardship in schools and the rising cost of living. Over 1,200 people were arrested, and buildings from Paris to Limoges were set alight.
lead_zh: 周六，法国各地爆发暴力冲突，数十万人走上街头，抗议学校条件艰苦和生活成本上涨。超过1200人被捕，从巴黎到利摩日多地的建筑被纵火焚烧。
preview: The interior ministry put the turnout at an estimated 550,000 and described the day as an "escalation in violence", with riot police in Pari
preview_zh: 内政部估计参与人数约为55万，并将当天定性为"暴力升级"，巴黎防暴警察直到傍晚仍在向人群发射催泪瓦斯并动用高压水枪。首都及多地建筑遭纵火，利摩日尤为严重，市政厅大火导致屋顶部分坍塌。多座城市还报告了抢劫以及针对市政厅和商铺的大规模破坏行为。
paragraphs: The interior ministry put the turnout at an estimated 550,000 and described the day as an "escalation in violence", with riot police in Paris deploying tear gas and water cannon against crowds into the evening. Buildings were torched in the capital and elsewhere, notably in Limoges, where a blaze at the town hall caused the roof to partially collapse. Looting and vandalism targeting city halls and businesses were reported in several cities.

Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said 150 police officers had been injured. Although the main Paris march appeared largely peaceful during the afternoon, groups later set fires in the street and torched vehicles, including at the Place de la République. Shops were ransacked, at least one restaurant was gutted, and riot police were seen charging at crowds and striking several people with batons.

In Lyon, Mayor Grégory Doucet called the burning of the city's tourist office "a tragedy", lamenting the loss of an iconic historic building; police said "hostile individuals" had prevented firefighters from tackling the blaze safely. A young man in Saint-Étienne reportedly lost his hand to a grenade. The ministry blamed "targeted acts of violence" by "hooded individuals" in Paris, Marseille, Rennes, Toulouse and Angers, with damage also reported in Grenoble, Avignon, Pau, Montpellier and Valence.

The unrest caps weeks of student protests over staff shortages and dilapidated lycées, now bolstered by trade unions and the "yellow vest" movement. It comes as France enters deep political uncertainty: President Emmanuel Macron leaves office next year, and polls suggest April's election could pit Marine Le Pen against Jean-Luc Mélenchon, who joined the demonstrations and accused police of "unleashing" on protesters. Lecornu branded those remarks "dangerous and cynical", warning that no one would impose a political agenda through violence.
paragraphs_zh: 内政部估计参与人数约为55万，并将当天定性为"暴力升级"，巴黎防暴警察直到傍晚仍在向人群发射催泪瓦斯并动用高压水枪。首都及多地建筑遭纵火，利摩日尤为严重，市政厅大火导致屋顶部分坍塌。多座城市还报告了抢劫以及针对市政厅和商铺的大规模破坏行为。
总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼表示，已有150名警察受伤。尽管巴黎主游行在下午大体和平，但入夜后一些团体在街头纵火并焚烧车辆，包括共和国广场等地标区域。商店遭到洗劫，至少一家餐厅被烧毁，防暴警察被拍到冲向人群并用警棍击打数人。
在里昂，市长格雷戈里·杜塞称该市旅游局大楼被烧是"一场悲剧"，痛惜这座标志性历史建筑被毁；警方称"敌对分子"阻止消防员安全灭火。据报道，圣艾蒂安一名年轻男子被手榴弹炸掉一只手。内政部指责巴黎、马赛、雷恩、图卢兹和昂热等地出现"蒙面人员"的"有针对性暴力行为"，格勒诺布尔、阿维尼翁、波城、蒙彼利埃和瓦朗斯也报告了建筑受损。
这波动荡为持续数周的学生抗议画上句号，抗议起因是高中师资短缺和校舍破旧，如今又得到工会和"黄背心"运动的声援。与此同时，法国正步入深刻的政治不确定期：总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙将于明年卸任，民调显示4月大选可能成为玛丽娜·勒庞与让-吕克·梅朗雄之间的对决，后者参加了示威并指责警察对示威者"放手施暴"。勒科尔尼称这些言论"危险而玩世不恭"，并警告任何人都不能以暴力强推政治议程。

vocab.note: 常与 in 连用，如 escalation in violence
新闻用词，比 burn 更具动感
be gutted by fire 指内部被烧空
正式用词，后接名词或 that 从句

vocab.zh: 标志性的；极具代表性的

vocab.note: 此处指人数得到声援而增加
pit A against B，常用于选举、比赛
brand sth as... 正式且带批评意味

vocab.zh: 玩世不恭的；冷酷算计的
